items.gate_reason: Per the boundary rules, a figure or image arising from the unconscious is generation (inverse direction); derivation is strictly for tradition-to-tradition transmission.
The subject (great-mother) shows itself under the guise of the object (witch), which fits the directionality and definition of manifestation, not symbolization.
'contains' is a direct seed for the composition family, representing a part-whole relationship rather than a structural position.
The quote asserts a goal-direction ('longing to attain rebirth'), which classifies as telos regardless of the surface relation string.
The subject is the image formulating the less formulable object ('union of opposites'), which fits symbolization rather than manifestation.
The quote identifies the subject as an instance of a kind or role ('As a psychopomp'), which is classification, not composition.
The quote asserts equivalence of the terms themselves ('the centre, or what we would call the self'), which routes to archetypal-identity per the indistinguishability rule.
'domain-of' designates a place or abode, which falls under structural-position, not the part-whole relationship of composition.
The subject showing itself under various guises ('now a witch... now a whore') is manifestation, not doctrinal derivation.
The quote records an act of belief by a named carrier (the Church Fathers), which routes to doctrinal-attribution rather than projection.
The relation 'prefigures' and the quote's 'forerunner of' indicate typological anticipation, which is prefiguration, not projection.
The quote explicitly asserts an act of joining ('the union of opposites'), which belongs to the union family, not kinship.
The quote explicitly asserts a 'relationship of identity' between the terms themselves, which routes to archetypal-identity per the indistinguishability rule.
The string 'signifies' and the quote's use of 'emblems... signify' point to symbolization, not correspondence.
The boundary rules explicitly map expression relations ('dogma expresses collective-unconscious') to symbolization, not correspondence.
The relation 'conjoined-with' and the quote describe an act of joining distinct terms, which is the definition of union, not correspondence.
The quote explicitly states the subject 'changes into' the object, which is the definition of transformation.
The quote states the subject 'stands for' the object, which is a clear case of symbolization, not an unclassified relation.
The quote explicitly identifies the subject as 'projections of' the object, which belongs in the projection family.

false_positives.reason: A dream is an event or state, not a structure, so 'appears-in' a dream does not fit structural-position and has no clear family.
The quote asserts the devil 'appears as' the demiurge, which is a manifestation relation, overriding the 'is-identified-with' string.

threshold: PASS = every planted item caught with the correct family named (should_be == was) and every class at quota; one miss or misdiagnosis in any class = FAIL. Set 2026-08-12 before the run (RULES #11). Specificity is reported, never gating.
independence_note: Gate independence is NOMINAL, not cross-vendor: the gate model is the same model as one of the two production proposer arms (both gemini-3.1-pro). Within-vendor role separation only — see docs/RULES.md #1 and the 2026-08-12 inspection note in BACKLOG.md item 7.
